subject: 液滴入水异常表征与改进 (droplet water-entry anomaly: characterization and remediation)
discipline_note: Predictions below were written and committed BEFORE any simulation was run (see git history of this file: it precedes src/multiphase/ and runs/in59p1/). No number in this file may be edited after the fact; the post-mortem records hit/miss verbatim.

roles.pi: 攻关负责人 (owns problem tree, gate decisions)
roles.theorist: 理论研究者 (interface mechanics literature: YL balance, parasitic currents, added mass)
roles.engineer: 实现工程师 (SC-LBM D2Q9 implementation, two force-coupling routes)
roles.challenger: 挑战者 (independent right to judge; hunts counter-examples, controls the 'is this real?' question)
roles.verifier: 独立验证者 (blind-sequence recompute from the frozen results.json)

case_family.model: single-component Shan-Chen pseudopotential LBM, D2Q9, SRT-BGK, periodic in x and y, no solid walls
case_family.baseline_route: A/legacy: pseudopotential force + shifted-equilibrium forcing (u_eq = u + tau*F/rho), no source term -- the coupling used by most MCMP/CAC production codes ported from the 2000s
case_family.improved_route: B/balanced: identical psi and identical force, but Guo(2002) complete forcing term S_i = (1-1/(2tau)) w_i [3(c_i-u).F + 9(c_i.u)(c_i.F)] and u = sum(c f) + F/(2rho)
case_family.why_the_two_routes_are_a_controlled_comp: Only the force-to-population coupling changes; psi, force stencil, tau, grid and initial data are bitwise identical between A and B. Any difference is therefore attributable to the coupling alone.

hypotheses.route: A -> B (force coupling / temporal discretisation of the force)
hypotheses.statement: 液滴入水算例中的异常（伪流、动量不守恒、入水冲量偏差）主要来自力的时间推进格式：shifted-equilibrium 方案把整步力塞进平衡态速度，等于对力做了一阶（显式）近似，产生 O(dt) 的伪质量通量与伪动量。把耦合换成 Guo 完整源项（二阶）即可把异常压掉一个量级。
theory_basis: Guo, Zheng & Shi, Phys. Fluids 14 (2002) 2007: 完整源项是力项的二阶格式，缺项会留下 (1-1/(2tau)) 相关的伪项
Wagner, Phys. Rev. E 67 (2003) 056703: 伪流(parasitic currents)是离散力与离散平衡态之间不平衡的直接后果
Huang, Sukop & Lu, Phys. Rev. E 91 (2015) 013310: SC 力实施格式决定机械稳定性与伪流幅值

blind_predictions.prediction: route A in [5e-3, 5e-2]; route B <= route A / 3

blind_predictions.quantity: |P(t)-P(0)| / P_scale, P = sum(rho u) over periodic box (must be 0 in the continuum)

blind_predictions.case: entry, u0=0.05, R_drop=8, pool density = drop density
blind_predictions.quantity: impact velocity ratio u_after/u_before vs potential-flow 1/(1+C_A)=0.5 (C_A=1 for a 2D cylinder)
spurious current exponent, u_max vs tau
blind_predictions.prediction: A decreases steeply with tau (-1.5..-2.5 log-log slope); B flatter (slope magnitude < 1)

hypotheses.falsified_if: B does not reduce u_max by >= 2x, or momentum drift of B is not lower than A, or impact ratio of B is farther from 0.5 than A

hypotheses.route: spatial: discrete gradient / interface thickness / curvature (needs a different fix than the forcing)
hypotheses.statement: 异常的另一半来自空间离散：伪势力的格点梯度非各向同性与界面厚度有限，令曲率估计偏差、Laplace 定律有系统误差，且界面方向（0° vs 45°）会给出不同的等效表面张力。这部分换forcing格式治不了，只能靠界面/梯度改进（提高各向同性阶数、界面加宽或 EDM）。
theory_basis: Sbragaglia et al., J. Comput. Phys. 222 (2007) 471: 用高阶各向同性有限差分梯度可显著降低伪流
Shan & Chen, Phys. Rev. E 47 (1993) 1815: 伪势 EOS p = cs^2 rho + (G cs^2 / 2) psi^2，界面厚度有限
Kupershtokh, Medvedev & Karpov, Comput. Math. Appl. 58 (2009) 965: 精确差分法(EDM)消除伪流的机制是让离散力与离散平衡态一致

blind_predictions.quantity: Laplace law residual: Delta_p*R/(2) should be R-independent (constant sigma); report relative spread across R
blind_predictions.prediction: relative spread <= 10% for both routes; improving the forcing changes sigma by < 2x

blind_predictions.case: droplet area-equivalent circle: axis-aligned vs 45-degree-lattice-rotated initial datum, same area
blind_predictions.prediction: difference <= 5% for both routes (isotropic D2Q9 weights suppress leading anisotropy), i.e. no orientation pathology

blind_predictions.quantity: Delta_p*R/2 vs a sigma obtained independently from a flat (planar) interface pressure-deficit integral
blind_predictions.prediction: |sigma_flat - sigma_Laplace| / sigma_flat <= 15% (curvature + finite thickness error, NOT < 3%), improving with R

hypotheses.falsified_if: sigma varies by > 10% across R, or 0deg/45deg differ by > 5%, or the forcing change shifts sigma by > 2x

discriminating_experiment.design: 2x2 factorial: {route A, route B} x {static droplet family, entry case}. H-A is supported iff route B improves spurious current AND momentum drift AND impact ratio simultaneously, while sigma (a purely spatial/interface quantity) stays put. H-B is supported to the extent sigma itself carries the residual error and is insensitive to the forcing route.
discriminating_experiment.honesty_rule: Any prediction missed beyond its stated tolerance is recorded as MISS in the post-mortem without re-widening the tolerance.

six_dimension_gates.correctness: mass conservation exact (<=1e-12 relative), uniform-fluid quiescent state stays exactly at rest, momentum conservation in a periodic closed box
six_dimension_gates.accuracy: Laplace law Delta_p = 2 sigma/R linear in 1/R (R^2 >= 0.99) and cross-scheme sigma agreement; added-mass impact ratio vs 1/2
six_dimension_gates.stability: no blow-up over the tau sweep and the entry run; max Mach number <= 0.1; density stays positive
six_dimension_gates.efficiency: wall-clock seconds per 1e6 lattice-node updates, measured, plus steps to reach the QoI
six_dimension_gates.reproducibility: bitwise identical rerun of the same case in the same process and in a fresh process
six_dimension_gates.applicability: declared domain of validity: density ratio achieved, Mach, interface thickness in lattice units, 2D, no solid boundary
